Looking at the qlang documentation, I need to construct queries for 14 tasks. Let me work through each systematically.

Key insights from the docs:
- Soft reads (`at`) return null for missing parts; strict reads (`/`) fail
- `allOf` chains multiple conditions; each is evaluated against the current value
- `groupBy` partitions items and returns a map; `map` on maps transforms values while keeping keys
- Commands like `split`, `filter`, `sort` take modifiers (quotes with `~()` for code)
- Names (`:var /` or `:var value`) hold values for downstream use

Let me trace through a few critical ones:

**T1**: Filter users with active=true, non-null email ending with "@example.com" (case-insensitive)

**T3**: Count users per country; soft-read profile and country to handle missing fields, coalesce null to "unknown"

**T6**: Sort issues by comments descending, then number ascending; construct result objects

**T8**: Merge two maps (dependencies), use names to access root from inner context

**T12-T13**: Parse CSV rows, use `:line /` to store the row, then reference it when extracting multiple fields

**T14**: No input file—provide literal array

T1: `/data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (/email | ne null) (/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count`

T2: `/data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)`

T3: `/data/users | groupBy ~(at /profile | at /country | coalesce "unknown") | map ~(count)`

T4: `/data/users | map ~(at /profile | at /age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2`

T5: `/ | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map ~(/labels | map ~(/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort`

T6: `/ | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~({:number /number, :assignee (at /assignee | at /login | coalesce null)})`

T7: `/ | filter ~(allOf (/state | eq "open") (/assignee | ne null)) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count)`

T8: `:root / | /dependencies | union (:root | /devDependencies) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~([/0 "@" /1] | join "") | sort`

T9: `/services | filter ~(allOf (at /enabled | coalesce false) (/port | gt 8000)) | map ~(/name | lower) | sort | join ","`

T10: `lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | map ~(/2) | groupBy ~(/) | map ~(count)`

T11: `lines | filter ~(contains "ms=") | map ~(split "ms=" | /1 | split " " | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round 1`

T12: `lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | eq "shipped") (/4 | ne "")) | map ~(:line / | /3 | parseJson | mul (/line | /4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2`

T13: `lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") (/4 | ne "")) | groupBy ~(/1) | map ~(map ~(:line / | /3 | parseJson | mul (/line | /4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2) | entries | sort ~([(/1 | desc)]) | take 2 | map ~({:customer /0, :total /1})`

T14: `["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"`
